=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text kept " KEPT\n"
text struck " STRUCK\n"
text tx " x "
text teq " = "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn halve n ulong to ulong
ret shr n 1
end
fn double n ulong to ulong
ret shl n 1
end
fn iseven n ulong to bool
ret eq and n 1 0
end
note left column halves to 1, right column doubles; rows with an even left number are struck out and
note the kept right numbers add up to the product
fn ethiop a ulong b ulong to ulong
s = ulong 0
l = a
r = b
while ge l 1 bound 64
emitu l
emit sp
emitu r
if iseven l
emit struck
else
emit kept
s = add s r
end
l = halve l
r = double r
end
ret s
end
fn main to int
p = ethiop 17 34
emitu 17
emit tx
emitu 34
emit teq
emitu p
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
17 34 KEPT
8 68 STRUCK
4 136 STRUCK
2 272 STRUCK
1 544 KEPT
17 x 34 = 578
</pre>
